connection_condition: No direct client-to-account column exists; the connection is indirect through account-holder records, where tab04.fld009 links a record to a client and tab04.fld001 links the same record to an account.
description: Clients relate to accounts through holder records. One account can have more than one holder, so client and account are not a simple one-to-one pairing.

connection_condition: tab03.fld002 carries a district identifier from the same 77-value domain as tab05.fld002.
description: A client's district of residence is a district in the district dimension; the value is role-scoped to the client and must not be conflated with the account's branch district.

connection_condition: tab01.fld002 carries a district identifier from the same 77-value domain as tab05.fld002; every branch identifier resolves to exactly one district row.
description: A branch location is a district; district statistics such as population and region describe the branch's district, while client counts describe the branch's account portfolio.

connection_condition: tab04.fld001 references tab01.fld001; holder records cannot exist without their account.
description: An account is composed of its holder records; every account has exactly one OWNER and may have additional DISPONENT holders.

connection_condition: tab04.fld009 corresponds to tab03.fld009; every holder record references exactly one client.
description: Each holder record names one client and the role that client plays on the account.

connection_condition: tab02.fld006 references tab04.fld006; each card belongs to exactly one holder record.
description: A card is issued to a holder record and cannot exist without it; there is exactly one card per card-issuing holder record.

connection_condition: tab06.fld001 references tab01.fld001; a loan cannot exist without its account.
description: A loan contract belongs to one account. In this dataset every loan account has exactly one loan.

connection_condition: tab08.fld001 references tab01.fld001; a transaction cannot exist without its account.
description: Transactions are the movements that make up an account's activity.

connection_condition: tab05.fld013 names the region of each district row; districts group into 8 regions.
description: A region is composed of districts. Region-level statistics are aggregations over their district rows, while the per-district statistics remain at district grain.
Age is derived from the birth date relative to a reference date; no age column is stored and the reference date is not defined by the data.
The 1995 unemployment rate is the base value of the increment formula.
The 1996 unemployment rate is the comparison value of the increment formula.
The salary gap is derived as the highest district average salary minus the lowest district average salary in the compared set.
Male client percentage is derived from client gender counts within the selected group.

connection_condition: Both columns classify the same transaction row; operation is finer-grained than type.
description: Transaction type and transaction operation are parallel classifications, not a hierarchy: VYDAJ includes VYBER, VYBER KARTOU and PREVOD NA UCET, while the type code VYBER is narrower than the operation code VYBER.
